Bill.BriefDescription: Protecting salmon and steelhead spawning beds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to salmon and steelhead spawning beds; adding a newsection to chapter 77.95 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.95 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall prohibit activities that harm or disturbspawning beds of salmon and steelhead and other fish on all rivers andstreams where spawning activities occur. (2) Prohibited activities include, but are not limited to, wadingon spawning beds, driving motor vehicles on spawning beds, use of highpowered jet or propellerdriven boats across spawning beds, dragginganchors through spawning beds, digging or removing gravel from spawningbeds, or any other physical disturbance capable of disturbing spawningfish or damaging or destroying nests of incubating eggs. Thedepartment shall determine the time periods these rules are in effect. (3) Necessary inriver activities are allowed by permit from thedepartment. (4) The department shall adopt rules to carry out this section, andmake the rules known in brochures that are disseminated to persons p. 1 SB 6297applying for fishing and boating licenses. The department mustdistribute the brochures widely to retail outlets that cater to outdoorrecreation. (5) The department shall work cooperatively with the tribalcomanagers for all fish resources in implementing and enforcing therequirements of this section. (6) A violation of this section is a natural resource infractionunder chapter 7.84 RCW. (7) The department shall report to the legislature concerning theeffectiveness of this section after at least two spawning cycles ofsalmon and steelhead have occurred.
